basicDetails.schemeName: Scheme of Human Resources Development in Sports- Exchange of Knowledge / Research / Ideas for Holding Training Programmes, Seminars, Workshops, Clinics and Conferences Within the Country

schemeContent.briefDescription: The scheme aims to strengthen sports knowledge and capacity building by providing financial assistance for organizing training and knowledge-sharing events.
schemeContent.detailedDescription_md: The component "Exchange of Knowledge / Research / Ideas – For Holding Training Programmes, Seminars, Workshops, Clinics and Conferences Within the Country" under the Scheme of Human Resources Development in Sports by the Department of Sports, Ministry of Youth Affairs & Sports, Government of India. The scheme aims to strengthen sports development through capacity building and knowledge exchange. Through this component, financial assistance is provided for organizing training programmes, seminars, workshops, clinics and conferences in India.
schemeContent.benefits_md: > **Financial Assistance:** - Economy class airfare for foreign experts. - Boarding and daily allowance for foreign experts. - Professional fees/remuneration for experts. - Travel expenses for trainers and experts. - Logistics and local transport for organizing events. - Boarding and lodging expenses of trainees and participants. - Financial assistance to Sports Authority of India, National Sports University, National Anti Doping Agency, National Dope Testing Laboratory, Lakshmibai National Institute of Physical Education, National Sports Federations and other eligible institutions for organizing national and international programmes.

children.text: The component "Exchange of Knowledge / Research / Ideas – For Holding Training Programmes, Seminars, Workshops, Clinics and Conferences Within the Country" under the Scheme of Human Resources Development in Sports by the Department of Sports, Ministry of Youth Affairs & Sports, Government of India. The scheme aims to strengthen sports development through capacity building and knowledge exchange. Through this component, financial assistance is provided for organizing training programmes, seminars, workshops, clinics and conferences in India.
Financial Assistance:
Economy class airfare for foreign experts.
Boarding and daily allowance for foreign experts.
Professional fees/remuneration for experts.
Travel expenses for trainers and experts.
Logistics and local transport for organizing events.
Boarding and lodging expenses of trainees and participants.

Financial assistance to Sports Authority of India, National Sports University, National Anti Doping Agency, National Dope Testing Laboratory, Lakshmibai National Institute of Physical Education, National Sports Federations and other eligible institutions for organizing national and international programmes.
Step 01:
The applicant should submit the application online through the dedicated portal,
dbtyas-sports.gov.in
. Only online applications received through this portal are accepted.
Step 02:

The applications, along with the recommendations of the Appraisal Committee, are then placed before the Designated Committee, which meets bi-monthly in the first or second week of every alternate month.
Step 03:
The decision of the Designated Committee in respect of selection of any application or proposal is final.
Step 04:
Selected candidates are intimated by the Department and are required to submit all documents in original to the Department of Sports for verification.
NOTE:
The applicant should ensure submit the mandatory report within 15 days.

Applications and proposals received on or before the 20th day of the preceding month, and complete in all respects, are first placed before the Appraisal Committee for examining the eligibility and technical aspects.

eligibilityCriteria.eligibilityDescription_md: 1. The applicant should be an eligible Government organization, autonomous body, university, institute or sports organization conducting sports-related training or knowledge-sharing programmes. 1. The proposed programme should facilitate exchange of knowledge or enhancement of professional skills in sports. 1. The programme should be approved by the Department of Sports. 1. The event may involve Indian or foreign experts for coaching, training or technical guidance.
